deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Grace Barbieri. Hvac tech. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Hard Candy, Dead Phone, Home key, Carpenter's square, Knife roll. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. Last night, something walked past the treeline on two legs. Too tall. It stopped. It listened. Then it kept going. Nobody slept after that.
